}
NDC_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "To strengthen climate resilience and management of Sri Lanka’s coastal and marine areas through forecasting, mapping, planning, prioritization, restoration, and conservation actions.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop an accurate forecasting system for sea level rise; establish a sea level database in Sri Lanka; conduct coastal hazard and vulnerability mapping for the entire coastal belt; incorporate climate change information into the coastal zone management plan (CZMP); identify, designate, and prioritize climate-sensitive coastal and marine areas; prepare management plans for enhancing resilience; restore coastal ecosystems such as coral reefs, mangroves, and sand dunes; improve conservation actions for marine mammals and other threatened species.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Sri Lanka’s coastal belt, coastal and marine areas, including coral reefs, mangroves, sand dunes, and habitats of marine mammals and other threatened species.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly specified in the target.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "An accurate sea level rise forecasting system and sea level database established; coastal hazard and vulnerability mapping covering the entire coastal belt of the country; climate change information incorporated into the coastal zone management plan; climate-sensitive coastal and marine areas identified, designated, and prioritized with management plans prepared; coastal ecosystems restored; and conservation actions for marine mammals and other threatened species improved."
NDC_5:

  "Target Audience": "National electricity and energy sector stakeholders; commercial, institutional, and residential sectors.",
  "Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased renewable electricity generation from Solar PV, Wind, Hydro and Sustainable Biomass; increased absorption of renewable energy; reduced thermal generation; improved energy efficiency and conservation in commercial, institutional, and residential sectors; conversion of fuel oil-based combined cycle power plants to Natural Gas and establishment of new NG plants where infrastructure is available; increased readiness for future deployment of clean energy technologies and grid supporting infrastructure."
}
NDC_6:

NDC_17:
"Goal/Purpose": "Adopt integrated river basin management; strengthen monitoring, assessment, and remedial action for groundwater and surface water in sensitive and drought-prone areas; promote climate-resilient water supply and sanitation; promote water conservation, efficient water use, and re-use of treated wastewater; establish and improve salinity barriers in rivers affected by climate-induced saline intrusion during drought; build capacity and public awareness for climate resilience; restore, rehabilitate, and augment irrigation systems; enhance water management in irrigation schemes; and assess river floods and adopt mitigation measures and early warning systems for priority basins.",

"Ecosystem/Area": "River basins, groundwater and surface water systems, drought-prone and highly sensitive areas, rivers affected by saline intrusion, water supply and sanitation systems, irrigation systems and schemes, and priority river basins in Sri Lanka.",

"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Integrated river basin management adopted; water resources monitored and vulnerability assessed in sensitive and drought-prone areas with remedial measures implemented; climate-resilient water supply and sanitation promoted and implemented; improved water conservation, efficient water use, and re-use of treated wastewater; salinity barriers established or improved in affected rivers; strengthened capacity and public awareness on climate resilience; restored, rehabilitated, and augmented irrigation systems; enhanced water management in irrigation schemes; and flood mitigation measures and early warning systems adopted for priority basins."

NBSAP_1:
"Goal/Purpose": "Restore degraded terrestrial, freshwater, marine and coastal ecosystems to enhance nature’s contributions to people and the planet.",
"Action/Intervention": "Adopt the IUCN Global Ecosystems typology; prepare and update the Red List of Ecosystems for Sri Lanka by 2030; identify and map degraded natural habitats by ecosystem type and level of degradation; prepare a list of priority sites for restoration; compile restoration actions conducted so far and identify sound ecological practices that can be upscaled; develop and implement a national ecosystem restoration plan for terrestrial, coastal and marine ecosystems, including strategies for afforestation, enhancement, restoration and connectivity; establish a National Compensatory Afforestation Fund; implement mangrove and riverbank restoration and forest conservation projects for watersheds; mainstream EbA and Eco-DRR in development planning and the education system; develop assessment methodologies for biodiversity and ecosystem service values; integrate biodiversity and ecosystem service values into educational curricula and national accounts.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Degraded terrestrial, freshwater, marine and coastal ecosystems; natural habitats; mangroves; riverbanks; forests; watersheds.",
"Target Audience": "Sri Lanka; development planning and education sectors; treasury.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Degraded ecosystems are restored, priority restoration sites are identified, restoration practices are upscaled, ecosystem connectivity is established, biodiversity and ecosystem service values are assessed and integrated into curricula and national accounts, and nature’s contributions to people and the planet are enhanced."
NBSAP_2:
"Goal/Purpose": "Incorporate biodiversity considerations into national policies, plans, and decision-making, and integrate nature-based approaches into spatial and urban planning to prevent loss of biodiversity and enhance human well-being.",
"Action/Intervention": "Update the National Physical Plan considering biodiversity and including all Protected Areas as well as ESAs, OECMs, EPAs, MPAs, FMAs, and SMAs; conduct a Strategic Environment Assessment for the updated National Physical Plan; develop a mechanism to align new development projects with the updated National Physical Plan; develop the capacity and raise awareness of national and local authority planners to make their designs biodiversity friendly; develop a mechanism to incorporate blue-green spaces in city and urban plans and enhance urban greenness through street trees, green roofs, living walls, and enriched home gardens; integrate NBSAP actions into relevant sectoral annual plans and budgets; make biodiversity impact assessments mandatory for all GoSL funded projects; develop a biodiversity CSR framework for effective and transparent engagement of private sector and NGOs for biodiversity actions; develop and adopt the Biodiversity Policy of Sri Lanka by integrating it with related action plans.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "National policies, plans, and decision-making; spatial and urban planning; city and urban plans; Protected Areas, ESAs, OECMs, EPAs, MPAs, FMAs, and SMAs.",
"Target Audience": "National and local authority planners; GoSL funded projects; private sector and NGOs; relevant sectors involved in annual plans and budgets.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Biodiversity considerations integrated into national and sectoral planning and decision-making; nature-based approaches incorporated into spatial and urban planning; biodiversity-friendly planning mechanisms established; blue-green spaces and urban greenness enhanced; biodiversity loss prevented; human well-being enhanced."
NBSAP_3:
"Goal/Purpose": "Conserve 30% of the island’s land and inland waters, and 10% of the coastal and marine areas, including areas outside protected areas, by mainstreaming OECMs and other national approaches.",
"Action/Intervention": "Update the protected area gap analysis (2006) and implement a strategy to protect critical habitats outside the protected area network; accurately map and effectively manage the existing protected area network to achieve identified conservation goals, green listing standards, connectivity of protected areas, and true representation of the island’s biodiversity; identify, declare and manage ecosystems of special importance (e.g., blue carbon ecosystems and lagoons) as protected/managed areas; establish a national framework for Other Effective Area-based Conservation Measures (OECMs) and recognize and manage OECMs on land, inland waters and marine areas; assess the coastal and marine sector and identify and designate areas that need protection; safeguard key paleo-biodiversity sites through declaration and management of such sites and promotion of some sites as paleo-tourism destinations; develop and strengthen implementation of special management areas, conservation areas and affected areas as defined by the CC&CRM Act.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Island land, inland waters, coastal areas, marine areas, areas outside the protected area network, critical habitats, ecosystems of special importance, blue carbon ecosystems, lagoons, and key paleo-biodiversity sites.",
"Target Audience": "Protected area network managers and national authorities responsible for protected areas, OECMs, coastal and marine management, and implementation of the CC&CRM Act.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "30% of the island’s land and inland waters conserved, and 10% of coastal and marine areas conserved, including areas outside protected areas; OECMs mainstreamed and recognized across land, inland waters and marine areas; protected and managed areas mapped, designated and managed to support conservation goals, connectivity, biodiversity representation, and green listing standards."
NBSAP_4:
"Goal/Purpose": "Halt species extinction, protect genetic diversity, and manage human-wildlife conflict.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a national list of species and ecosystem types with annual updating; update the national red lists once in five years and ensure that the data is shared with the IUCN Global Red List; conduct risk assessments to identify species that are vulnerable to climate change; develop and implement recovery plans for prioritized threatened species as well as climate vulnerable species; establish ex situ conservation facilities such as botanic gardens, zoos, aquaria, wetland parks, arboreta, medicinal gardens, urban parks, natural history museums, plant herbaria, or upgrade and improve existing facilities in each bioclimatic zones for conservation, education and research; support establishment of captive breeding and propagation programs to assist species recovery programs; strengthen existing animal care shelters under the Department of Wildlife Conservation for rehabilitation of confiscated, injured and displaced animals and develop guidelines for reintroduction of rehabilitated species back to the wild; develop and implement species-level management plans for threatened species that cause conflict.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Species and ecosystem types; ex situ conservation facilities in each bioclimatic zones; wildlife conservation and human-wildlife conflict management.",
"Target Audience": "Department of Wildlife Conservation; institutions managing ex situ conservation facilities; species recovery and rehabilitation programs.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Species extinction halted; genetic diversity protected; human-wildlife conflict managed; updated national species and ecosystem data and red lists shared with the IUCN Global Red List; identified climate-vulnerable species; recovery plans and management plans implemented for threatened and climate-vulnerable species; strengthened rehabilitation and reintroduction of confiscated, injured and displaced animals."
NBSAP_5:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure wild species are managed, used, and traded sustainably, safely, and legally, providing benefits to people and the planet.",
"Action/Intervention": "Identify gaps in enforcement of tracking, monitoring, and prosecuting illegal trade of scheduled species; update legislation and regulations to address identified gaps and align with international conventions such as CITES; control targeted and non-targeted removal of marine, freshwater, and terrestrial species; provide protection to breeding grounds of marine turtles and strengthen ex situ conservation programs; implement best practices to minimize destructive harvesting methods used for biological resources from terrestrial, aquatic, and marine systems; update wild species data collection systems to support sustainable management; develop and implement recovery plans for species stocks depleted due to overexploitation; identify gaps in Fishery Management Areas and implement programs to address the identified gaps; update and implement the Sri Lanka National Plan of Action for conservation of important wild species including sharks.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Wild species management, use, and trade across marine, freshwater, terrestrial, aquatic, and marine systems, including Fishery Management Areas and breeding grounds of marine turtles.",
"Target Audience": "People and the planet.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Wild species are managed, used, and traded sustainably, safely, and legally; illegal trade enforcement gaps are addressed; legislation is updated and aligned with international conventions; destructive harvesting methods are minimized; depleted species stocks have recovery plans; and conservation of important wild species, including sharks and marine turtles, is strengthened."
NBSAP_6:
{
  "Goal/Purpose": "Prevention and control of Invasive Alien Species (IAS) for enhanced biosecurity.",
  "Action/Intervention": "Review and update existing laws and policies related to IAS management; establish a mechanism for updating National IAS lists every five years; conduct a national assessment of invasive alien species, including development of a priority list of fauna and flora for control and management; strengthen border control agencies by improving detection capacity and guidelines for prevention of entry; establish a sustainable IAS detection, monitoring and reporting system; establish a mechanism to remove and destroy IAS that are commonly in use such as aquarium fish and ornamental plants that are listed as IAS; develop and implement species specific management plans and monitor for five key IAS; conduct a national level awareness campaign on invasive alien species and their impacts on natural habitats.",
  "Ecosystem/Area": "Biosecurity; natural habitats; invasive alien species management.",
  "Target Audience": "Border control agencies; authorities responsible for IAS management, laws and policies, national IAS lists, detection, monitoring and reporting, removal and destruction of listed IAS, species management planning, and awareness campaigns.",
  "Expected Impact/Outcome": "Enhanced biosecurity; updated laws and policies related to IAS management; updated National IAS lists every five years; a national assessment of IAS and a priority list of fauna and flora for control and management; improved detection capacity and guidelines for prevention of entry; a sustainable IAS detection, monitoring and reporting system; mechanisms for removal and destruction of commonly used listed IAS; species specific management plans and monitoring for five key IAS; increased awareness of invasive alien species and their impacts on natural habitats."
}

"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Pollution and waste releases are reduced to levels that are not harmful to biodiversity and ecosystem functions and services; reduced reliance on agrochemical usage; improved water, air and soil quality monitoring; improved ecological resilience of natural ecosystems; more regularized waste collection and disposal in urban areas and areas near Sensitive / Protected sites."
NBSAP_8:
"Goal/Purpose": "Minimize the impact of climate change on biodiversity and build resilience.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish permanent monitoring plots in climate boundaries to determine shifts in ecosystem and species distribution; demarcate and establish buffer zones around high-quality habitats to facilitate adaptation to habitat shift; map and restore riparian areas in the boundaries of shifting climate zones to establish connectivity corridors to facilitate migration of habitats and critical species; establish ecological networks and connectivity corridors by improving the management of protected areas, creating new habitats and restoring degraded habitats; carry out a national assessment of the impact of climate change on identified vulnerable species and ecosystems and develop potential mitigation and adaptation strategies; carry out an assessment of species undergoing range expansion due to climate change and examine their impacts on ecosystems and livelihoods.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity, ecosystems, high-quality habitats, riparian areas, protected areas, degraded habitats, and shifting climate zones.",
"Target Audience": "Not explicitly provided.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced impact of climate change on biodiversity; improved resilience; determination of shifts in ecosystem and species distribution; facilitated adaptation to habitat shift; established connectivity corridors and ecological networks to support migration of habitats and critical species; improved management of protected areas; restoration of degraded habitats; national assessment of impacts on vulnerable species and ecosystems with mitigation and adaptation strategies developed; assessment of range-expanding species and their impacts on ecosystems and livelihoods."
NBSAP_9:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enable sustainable consumption choices to reduce waste and overconsumption.",
"Action/Intervention": "Improve conversion efficiency of raw material to final products; mainstream and promote circular economy approach across all segments of society as well as production and service sectors to reduce waste; mainstream Extended Producer Responsibility and Polluters Pay across the supply chain to ensure sustainable sourcing, production and consumption from cradle-to-grave; introduce a module on sustainable consumption, waste reduction and responsible food use into school curriculum; foster lifestyles that encourage sustainable consumption and use of environmentally friendly products; design and develop programs to raise awareness on circular economy and ecological footprint concepts among the general public.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Consumption, waste, production and service sectors, supply chain, education, and public awareness.",
"Target Audience": "All segments of society, production and service sectors, supply chain actors, schools, and the general public.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Reduced waste and overconsumption; sustainable sourcing, production and consumption from cradle-to-grave; increased awareness of circular economy and ecological footprint concepts; increased sustainable consumption and use of environmentally friendly products."
NBSAP_10:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enhance sustainability in agriculture, aquaculture, fisheries, forestry and tourism through wise use of biodiversity.",
"Action/Intervention": "Develop a national biodiversity mainstreaming roadmap with sector-specific targets and M&E indicators for identified sectors (food systems, tourism, etc.); facilitate the development and scaling up of agrotourism initiatives; mainstream underutilized, lesser known or neglected crops, livestock, poultry and fish through technological advancements and innovation; document and adopt useful elements of traditional knowledge/practices of unique agroecosystems to address current issues; identify and conserve useful biodiversity and ecosystem services such as natural enemies, pollinators and soil microorganisms for sustainable agricultural productivity; implement circa situm (on-farm) conservation for wild relatives, traditional varieties, land races and native varieties; promote agroforestry models including home gardens for diversified income and biodiversity benefits; facilitate agroforestry models for riparian habitats to enhance connectivity and trap sediment flow into waterways.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture, aquaculture, fisheries, forestry, tourism, food systems, agroecosystems, home gardens, and riparian habitats.",
"Target Audience": "Identified sectors including food systems and tourism.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Enhanced sustainability in agriculture, aquaculture, fisheries, forestry and tourism through the wise use of biodiversity; sustainable agricultural productivity; diversified income and biodiversity benefits; enhanced connectivity and reduced sediment flow into waterways."
NBSAP_11:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enable businesses to assess, disclose and mitigate risks and negative impacts on biodiversity, while benefiting from and supporting biodiversity and taking steps to minimize harmful incentives while upscaling positive incentives.",
"Action/Intervention": "Integrate biodiversity strategies into business strategies of companies; develop and implement a business and biodiversity action plan for the private sector; develop tools such as biopoints, payment for ecosystem services and the necessary policies for businesses to benefit from biodiversity conservation; prepare a mechanism to harness private sector participation and investment in biodiversity conservation; guide the private sector to report their initiatives on biodiversity conservation through their websites and national platforms; coordinate identification and removal of perverse incentives such as tax exemptions, subsidies and concessional loans that damage biodiversity and ecosystem services; provide incentives for conservation of biodiversity; support businesses to assess, disclose and mitigate biodiversity risks and negative impacts.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Business/private sector and biodiversity conservation.",
"Target Audience": "Businesses, companies, and the private sector.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Businesses assess, disclose and mitigate biodiversity risks and negative impacts; increased private sector participation and investment in biodiversity conservation; reporting of private sector biodiversity initiatives through websites and national platforms; minimized harmful incentives and increased positive incentives for biodiversity conservation."
NBSAP_12:
"Goal/Purpose": "To strengthen biosafety while accruing the benefits of biotechnology.",
"Action/Intervention": "Strengthen the policy on biosafety; develop mechanisms to implement the National Biosafety Act and relevant regulations in place; establish risk analysis procedures for emerging technologies and strengthen capacity for risk assessment; enhance Sri Lanka’s scientific capacity on biosafety; promote use of modern biotechnology in bioprospecting of both animal and plant genetic resources; promote conservation of underutilized plant species, livestock and their wild relatives; carry out molecular genetics research to identify and use beneficial genes of wild relatives and traditional varieties with the aim of improving cultivated crop and animal varieties.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biosafety, biotechnology, animal and plant genetic resources, agriculture, and bioprospecting.",
"Target Audience": "Sri Lanka’s biosafety policymakers and regulators, scientific and research institutions, and stakeholders involved in animal and plant genetic resources, agriculture, and biotechnology.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened biosafety policy and implementation mechanisms, improved risk analysis and risk assessment capacity for emerging technologies, enhanced scientific capacity on biosafety, increased use of modern biotechnology in bioprospecting, conservation of underutilized plant species, livestock and their wild relatives, and identification and use of beneficial genes to improve cultivated crop and animal varieties."
NBSAP_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enable benefit sharing from biological resources, related digital sequence information, and traditional knowledge.",
"Action/Intervention": "Review and strengthen the policy, legal and institutional frameworks for benefit sharing; prepare national ABS guidelines, model contracts, Mutually Agreed Terms (MAT), Prior Informed Consent (PIC) and compliance mechanisms; establish a national ABS helpdesk; conduct pilot tests for community-level ABS protocols with IPLCs, documenting traditional knowledge and developing benefit-sharing mechanisms; carry out awareness campaigns on ABS for youth, IPLCs, researchers, and the private sector; promote and mobilise cultural practices and traditional wisdom related to biodiversity.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biological resources, related digital sequence information, traditional knowledge, and biodiversity governance.",
"Target Audience": "IPLCs, youth, researchers, private sector, and institutions involved in ABS policy, legal, and compliance frameworks.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Strengthened frameworks, guidance, contracts, consent and compliance mechanisms, operational ABS support services, tested community-level ABS protocols, documented traditional knowledge, developed benefit-sharing mechanisms, increased awareness of ABS, and promotion of cultural practices and traditional wisdom related to biodiversity."
NBSAP_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure that decision-making relating to biodiversity is based on the best possible available data and a participatory approach, with an emphasis on access to justice and information.",
"Action/Intervention": "Establish a National Biodiversity Information System to document the country’s biodiversity, populate the database, and update it regularly to support awareness and decision-making; facilitate establishment of a searchable database on traditional knowledge, beliefs and practices of biodiversity under the proposed NBIS; strengthen knowledge platforms on the Biosafety Clearing-house and Access to Benefit Sharing; undertake surveys to gather data on unexplored areas and data deficient species; strengthen public consultation processes in the formulation of legislation, policies and plans that directly or indirectly impact biodiversity; develop an interface through which the public can easily access key biodiversity-related documents such as national plans, national policies, management plans, gazette notifications, and Environmental Impact Assessment reports; develop a mechanism for active involvement and engagement of indigenous peoples and local communities in decision-making processes affecting their way of life, customs and resources; strengthen the national clearing house mechanism as a platform for sharing information with the public; establish and support a journalist forum to regularly disseminate scientific findings and their implications to the general public in a user-friendly manner.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity governance, biodiversity information systems, biosafety, access and benefit sharing, and public participation in biodiversity-related decision-making.",
"Target Audience": "Decision-makers; the public; indigenous peoples and local communities; journalists; stakeholders involved in the formulation of biodiversity-related legislation, policies and plans.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved availability and regular updating of biodiversity data; increased public access to biodiversity information and key documents; stronger public consultation and participation in biodiversity-related decision-making; greater involvement of indigenous peoples and local communities; strengthened information-sharing platforms; and decision-making that is better informed by available data and participatory processes."
NBSAP_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "Mobilize funding and enhance capacity at all levels for effective implementation of the NBSAP to achieve the NBTs by 2030.",
"Action/Intervention": "Ensure project proposals submitted to global financing mechanisms available for Sri Lanka, such as GEF, GBFF and GCF, are aligned with NBSAP actions; develop innovative financing mechanisms for sustainable self-financing for biodiversity and ecosystem services conservation; encourage public-private partnerships for biodiversity conservation investment and promote private sector and NGO investment in biodiversity conservation and sustainable use; encourage CSOs and the private sector to leverage global biodiversity funds; establish and use a citizen science platform to broaden public participation in biodiversity conservation and research; strengthen biodiversity elements in preschool and school curricula; develop and implement biodiversity-related training for all educator levels using local examples and case studies; develop and implement programmes encouraging youth involvement in biodiversity conservation and research in collaboration with tertiary education providers, government stakeholders and international platforms; enhance capacity to use modern technological tools for effective biodiversity monitoring and management; implement the BIOFIN plan and solutions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity and ecosystem services conservation; biodiversity monitoring, management, education, research, and financing under the NBSAP.",
"Target Audience": "All levels involved in NBSAP implementation, including project proponents seeking global financing, public sector actors, private sector, NGOs, CSOs, educators, youth, tertiary education providers, government stakeholders, and the public.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased funding and strengthened capacity at all levels for effective implementation of the NBSAP, supporting achievement of the NBTs by 2030."
NBSAP_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "Ensure gender equality and a gender-responsive approach for biodiversity conservation, management and sustainable use.",
"Action/Intervention": "Ensure that women and girls have equal opportunity and capacity to contribute to biodiversity conservation, sustainable use of biodiversity and access benefits accrued from biodiversity; ensure that women and girls are represented in governance and decision-making related to biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and benefit sharing; ensure relevant changes to laws, policies and cultural norms, including those related to land registration and ownership, to enable women to have access to and control of land and natural resources; ensure equal access for all women and girls to resources, services and technologies to support their engagement in the governance, conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity, including financial services, credit, education, training and relevant information; strengthen the capacity of national and local line agencies to mainstream gender-responsive approaches for biodiversity conservation; introduce mechanisms to recognize and appreciate the role of women in biodiversity conservation; provide more training and development opportunities for women and girls during the NBSAP implementation process.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Biodiversity conservation, management and sustainable use.",
"Target Audience": "Women and girls; national and local line agencies; governance and decision-making bodies related to biodiversity conservation, sustainable use and benefit sharing.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Women and girls have equal opportunity, capacity, representation, access to benefits, land and natural resources, and access to resources, services and technologies for engagement in biodiversity governance, conservation and sustainable use; gender-responsive approaches are mainstreamed in biodiversity conservation; the role of women in biodiversity conservation is recognized and appreciated."

NAgP_13:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve production and productivity of food and feed crops through a well-organized agricultural production system while harnessing the agro-ecological potential and strengthening the food system",
"Action/Intervention": "Prepare, approve and adopt guidelines for Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) for all crops and farming systems, while identifying relevant indicators; adopt need-based crop prioritization and crop zoning; introduce measures to minimize temporal variation in productivity with appropriate varieties, production technologies and Agro-met Advisories (AMAs) based on climate forecasting; adopt measures to produce more with less inputs using appropriate technology at affordable prices; adopt precision agriculture systems to enhance productivity and minimize negative impacts to ecosystem; support adoption of novel and appropriate technology/mechanization; encourage and strengthen Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) interventions focusing on the food systems; facilitate new technology generation and adoption; manage wildlife based on the carrying capacity of ecosystems and minimize their impact through scientifically-valid population control of animals; improve productivity of existing farm units with assured financial assistance to smallholders; introduce low-interest loan schemes to facilitate agricultural production and productivity; establish private-public-producer partnerships (PPPP) for machinery use; promote cropping systems and cropping patterns that provide higher returns to the investment; promote and support systematic home gardening; promote different production technologies, especially focusing on urban and peri-urban food systems and metro agriculture; develop and implement a national cropping plan for priority crops in consultation with all key stakeholders",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture and food systems, including food and feed crop production, farming systems, agro-ecological zones, urban and peri-urban food systems, and metro agriculture",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural producers, including smallholders; stakeholders involved in crop planning and farming systems; participants in private-public-producer partnerships; and key stakeholders consulted in the national cropping plan",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved production and productivity of food and feed crops, a well-organized agricultural production system, harnessed agro-ecological potential, strengthened food systems, enhanced input and land productivity, minimized temporal variation in productivity, reduced negative impacts on ecosystems, improved productivity of existing farm units, and minimized impacts of wildlife on agriculture and natural ecosystems"
NAgP_14:
"Goal/Purpose": "Strengthen delivery and management operations of physical agricultural inputs for their judicious use.",
"Action/Intervention": "Allocate an adequate budget for seed certification operations; ensure timely supply and/or production of quality inputs including seeds and planting material at affordable prices; establish PPP-based mechanisms to ensure timely availability of quality seed and planting material; decentralize and strengthen the seed certification process at provincial level; establish regional supply/service/renting machinery centers through PPP; establish village seed banks for conservation and sustainable utilization of traditional germplasm; promote private sector investment for local production of agricultural machinery and improvement of agricultural tools in Sri Lanka; establish a mechanism to certify machinery and other agricultural inputs used in Sri Lanka; establish a mechanism/system for production of fertilizer, stimulants, soil conditioners, and plant protection technologies to meet national needs; periodically establish, revisit, assess, and recommend measures to strengthen fertilizer standardization procedures; enforce a regulatory framework for organic/bio fertilizer production; provide authority to FOs, FPOs and FPCs to initiate actions for access to technologies and adoption using a cluster approach; strengthen institutional mechanisms for fertilizer import/production and distribution of quality-assured fertilizer; establish a mechanism to provide organized skilled-labour supply and contract farming; enforce regulations strictly in the import, production, and use of agricultural inputs.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture sector.",
"Target Audience": "FOs, FPOs, FPCs, private sector actors, PPP mechanisms, provincial-level institutions, and entities involved in seed certification, fertilizer import/production/distribution, machinery supply, and agricultural input regulation and use.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved delivery, management, certification, regulation, availability, affordability, standardization, and quality assurance of agricultural inputs for their judicious use."
NAgP_15:
"Goal/Purpose": "Improve productivity and sustainability of arable lands through optimum use of inputs and far-sighted management while safeguarding the farming community and the environment",
"Action/Intervention": "Promote adoption of seeds and planting material of local origin; adopt measures to optimize fertilizer use to obtain higher productivity; introduce and adopt new and appropriate technologies to increase nutrient use efficiency (NUE) and fertilizer use efficiency (FUE); adopt productivity-based and priority-based incentive mechanisms to support application of plant nutrients; introduce incentive-based mechanisms for gradual replacement of fertilizer subsidy from all sectors; enforce regulatory measures to safeguard ecosystem services; adopt prescription-based sale and use of pesticides with the involvement of Agrarian Service Centers and Farmer Cooperatives or establishment of kiosks; establish systems to promote integrated pest/weed management approaches to facilitate multiple use of plant protection technologies; introduce and promote adoption of novel and appropriate eco-friendly pest/weed control techniques including bio-pesticides, botanicals, and predator mites; develop and implement plans to increase the extent of land with organic ameliorations by providing an appropriate incentive package; introduce and increase the use of precision agriculture systems such as technologies for higher fertilizer use efficiency and soil test-based fertilizer application to enhance productivity and minimize negative impacts to ecosystem; conduct Continuing Professional Development (CPD) programs for agricultural extension officers and ARPAs on latest developments in eco-friendly agricultural production and management techniques; adopt measures to minimize abandoned lands from agricultural production; implement a social audit system as a mandatory activity in all incentive-based agricultural projects and programmes; establish agro-industrial zones using farmer cluster approach with agribusiness ventures and appropriate economic incentives; provide economic incentives based on cluster approach",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Arable lands; agriculture/farming sector",
"Target Audience": "Farming community; agricultural extension officers and ARPAs; Agrarian Service Centers; Farmer Cooperatives; agribusiness ventures",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Higher productivity of arable lands; improved sustainability of arable land management; optimized use of agricultural inputs; increased nutrient use efficiency and fertilizer use efficiency; greater adoption of eco-friendly production and pest/weed control techniques; increased land with organic ameliorations; minimized negative impacts on ecosystems; safeguarded ecosystem services, the farming community, and the environment; reduced abandoned agricultural lands"
NAgP_16:
"Goal/Purpose": "Enhance rational use of irrigation water through participatory management to improve irrigation water use efficiency.",
"Action/Intervention": "Take appropriate regulatory measures to avoid excessive use of ground water; promote rainwater harvesting for agricultural purposes; adopt water-saving technologies such as drip-irrigation, where applicable, to enhance irrigation water productivity in agro-ecosystems; adopt soil and water conservation measures to control soil erosion and land degradation; adopt catchment management practices through effective implementation of the Soil Conservation Act; adopt third season cultivation in paddy fields using residual moisture; rehabilitate reservoirs and irrigation systems with the support of line agencies to ensure efficient irrigation water supply to agricultural lands; integrate activities to ensure fish farming in reservoirs takes place in collaboration and coordination of all related local associations/societies; apply participatory management.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Irrigation water management in agricultural lands, agro-ecosystems, paddy fields, catchments, reservoirs, and irrigation systems.",
"Target Audience": "Agricultural water users, farmers, line agencies, and related local associations/societies involved in reservoir management and fish farming.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved irrigation water use efficiency, enhanced irrigation water productivity, avoidance of excessive groundwater use, efficient irrigation water supply to agricultural lands, controlled soil erosion and land degradation, and coordinated fish farming in reservoirs."
NAgP_17:

"Action/Intervention": "Establish a formal and well-coordinated mechanism to engage all stakeholders for technology development; provide financial and institutional support to develop cost-effective technology using locally available resources; upgrade the system of crop production forecasting with support from national and international development partners; promote adoption of technologies targeting value addition for perishables; adopt correct harvest and pre-harvest technologies, including packaging, to improve postharvest quality; strengthen technology transfer mechanisms through appropriate mechanisms; re-visit and restructure the existing authoritative body responsible for agriculture research to focus on establishing an Agriculture Research and Development/Extension Council; adopt mechanisms to promote use of ICT-based agriculture; introduce proven and appropriate technology into the sector through field validation",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Agriculture sector, specifically pre- and post-harvest management for sustainable agricultural production",
"Target Audience": "All stakeholders engaged in technology development and transfer in the agriculture sector, including the authoritative body responsible for agriculture research and national and international development partners",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Development and adoption of appropriate innovations and technologies in pre- and post-harvest management, improved postharvest quality, strengthened technology transfer, upgraded crop production forecasting, increased use of ICT-based agriculture, and sustainable agricultural production"

"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Minimized environmental damage from industrial facilities; reduced industrial process emissions; optimized preventive environmental measures; reduced risk of air, water, and soil pollution on human health and the environment; improved energy efficiency; reduced GHG emissions; effective and sustainable disposal of waste materials; optimal benefit to environmental management and sustainable development."
NEnvP_47:
"Goal/Purpose": "To ensure coordination among multiple government agencies involved in environmental management; enhance cooperation and coordination between government institutions and key stakeholders; recognize and facilitate the role of community-based organizations in environmental resource management; and create a comprehensive legal framework for an integrated approach to the restoration, protection, management and sustainable use of environmental resources in the country.",
"Action/Intervention": "Set up appropriate mechanisms for vertical and horizontal coordination among government agencies; establish necessary institutional and e-communication linkages between government institutions and key stakeholders including NGOs, CSOs, CBOs, youth, women organisations, and the private sector; recognize the role of community-based organizations and ensure necessary measures to facilitate their cooperation in community-based management of Common-Pool Resources and/or co-management of ecosystem services in partnership with government and non-state actors, with support of regional, international, bilateral and multilateral agencies; review existing legislation and create a comprehensive legal framework.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Environmental management; environmental resources; Common-Pool Resources (CPR); ecosystem services.",
"Target Audience": "Multiple government agencies at national and subnational levels; government institutions; key stakeholders including NGOs, CSOs, CBOs, youth, women organisations, private sector; community-based organizations; non-state actors; regional, international, bilateral and multilateral agencies.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Improved coordination among government agencies vertically and horizontally whenever necessary according to the needs of actions/programmes in operation; enhanced cooperation and coordination between government institutions and key stakeholders so that the strengths of respective stakeholders are harnessed to better overall outcomes of sustainable development; upheld and facilitated cooperation of community-based organizations in management of environmental resources, community-based management of Common-Pool Resources, and co-management of ecosystem services; and creation of a comprehensive legal framework for integrated restoration, protection, management and sustainable use of environmental resources in the country."
NEnvP_48:
"Goal/Purpose": "To mobilize sustainable finance and other resources to support the implementation of plans, programmes and projects to achieve the goals of NEP, including biodiversity conservation, climate change mitigation and adaptation, disaster risk mitigation, conservation and restoration of affected ecosystems, climate-friendly activities, and policy research on nationally important topics relating to environmental resources.",
"Action/Intervention": "Mobilize resources from diverse sources including budgetary finance, international donor funding, private sector investments, CSR funding, sponsorships from non-state actors, and contributions from community-based organizations; encourage and facilitate innovative funding schemes such as BIOFIN, ETS, REDD, Index Insurance Schemes, and PES in partnership with the private sector, international donors and CSOs; explore prospects for nature-based offset, compensation and investment mechanisms including conservation banking, mitigation banking, habitat banking and tree banking, and initiate pilot schemes; use available avenues to obtain loans, grants and technical assistance from agencies such as the Adaptation Fund, Green Climate Fund, Blue Carbon Financing, Global Environment Facility, Multilateral Fund of the Montreal Protocol and bilateral donor agencies; mobilize finances for policy research through e-platform based proposal calls.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Environmental resources; biodiversity conservation; climate change mitigation and adaptation; disaster risk mitigation; conservation and restoration of affected ecosystems; climate-friendly activities; policy research on environmental topics.",
"Target Audience": "Implementers of NEP plans, programmes and projects; private sector; international donors; CSOs; non-state actors; community-based organizations; agencies providing loans, grants and technical assistance; grassroots participants; youth.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Sustainable means of finance and other resources mobilized from diverse sources; innovative biodiversity, climate and disaster risk funding schemes encouraged and facilitated; prospects for nature-based financing mechanisms explored and pilot schemes initiated for scaling-up; loans, grants and technical assistance used to support well-designed projects with climate-friendly activities; strengthened policy responses towards environmental challenges and secured grassroots level and youth participation."
NEnvP_49:
"Goal/Purpose": "To encourage and promote the adoption of market-based instruments as viable and legitimate alternatives or complements to command-and-control measures for addressing environmental challenges, including conserving and protecting sensitive and critical ecosystems, mitigating climate-induced disasters and Human Animal Conflict, valuing non-market ecosystem services, and mainstreaming green accounting and ecosystem service values in policy decisions.",
"Action/Intervention": "Encourage adoption of market-based instruments; design and implement appropriate pilot schemes of PES; promote PES through economic incentives, capacity building support, education and training, and support for institutional development; facilitate introduction of innovative insurance products by providing necessary institutional support; support researchers to conduct studies on economic valuation of non-market ecosystem services and apply findings for planning and management; encourage and vigorously promote adoption of green accounting systems and mainstreaming the use of economic values of ecosystem services in macroeconomic and sectoral policy decisions.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Environmental challenges; sensitive and critical ecosystems; environmental resources; non-market ecosystem services; macroeconomic and sectoral policy decision-making.",
"Target Audience": "Key stakeholders including NGOs, CSOs, CBOs, youth/women organisations, private sector entities, researchers, and decision-makers involved in planning, management, macroeconomic, and sectoral policies.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Increased use of market-based instruments; implementation of PES pilot schemes for conservation and protection of sensitive and critical ecosystems; introduction of innovative insurance products for climate-induced disasters and Human Animal Conflict; availability and application of economic valuation studies of non-market ecosystem services for planning and management; adoption of green accounting systems and greater use of ecosystem service values in macroeconomic and sectoral policy decisions."
NEnvP_50:
"Goal/Purpose": "To encourage and facilitate research and development on technical, socio-economic, and policy aspects of the environment that are of national importance, in order to generate evidence-based solutions for environmental problems, improve environmental resource management, strengthen policy responses, and support the development and adaptation of innovative environmental management technologies.",
"Action/Intervention": "Provide financial and institutional support for research and development activities; facilitate the development and/or local adaptation of innovative environmental management technologies; support transfer of skills and knowledge on such technologies to relevant stakeholders; make all protected areas and conservation zones available for research purposes; encourage policy research on nationally important environmental resource topics, including overexploitation, poor management, policy gaps, and measures to address those gaps; facilitate cooperation with research organizations, universities, and subject experts.",
"Ecosystem/Area": "Environment; environmental resources; protected areas; conservation zones; environmental management technologies; policy research related to environmental resources.",
"Target Audience": "Research organizations, universities, subject experts, state actors, private sector, civil society, communities, and relevant multi-stakeholders involved in environmental management and research.",
"Expected Impact/Outcome": "Evidence-based solutions for environmental problems/issues; creation of further knowledge; improved management of resources in protected areas and conservation zones using research findings; transfer of skills and knowledge on environmental management technologies; strengthened policy responses towards environmental challenges."
NEnvP_51:
{
